32c16fc.summary: Coroutine that resolves one attack action (attacker hits target) over many timed states. It validates the attack, strips stealth/ambush/drop pod (requeueing the attack), runs sentry/shuriken pre-damage, applies combat damage with blast/stomp splash and counter-damage, then markerlight, cemetery logging and FinishResolvingAction.
comments: state 0: start of the attack; the action must name an attacking card
no attacking card: finish the action and throw an error that includes whose turn it is
ask the BattleManager whether this attack is still legal (target alive, in range, etc.)
attack is not allowed: cancel it
networked game, action came from the opponent: an illegal attack means cheating/desync, so the match is cancelled
our own illegal attack (or offline): just cancel the attack animation state on the attacker
attack is legal: tell the other player about it if this action originated locally
attacker has stealth: attacking reveals it, so remove it and requeue the attack
stealth removed and broadcast; clear pending damage and run the attack again as a continuation action
no stealth: check ambush next
ambushing unit attacks: it loses ambush and the attack is requeued like the stealth case
drop pod unit: the first attack lands it and removes the drop pod trait
no Landing trait: wait 1.3s for the landing, then continue (state 1)
unit has Landing: fire the Landing trigger and requeue the attack after it resolves
common exit for requeued paths: finish the action, reporting it as not consumed
state 1: resumed after the drop pod wait; re-check that the board still exists
state 1 re-entry point: continue with the tainted check
tainted attacker loses its duplicitous status, then waits a short delay (state 2)
state 2 entry: main attack resolution starts here
action type 0x4a seems to be the normal attack; other types first check if an ability cancels the attack
check whether any unit cancels this attack (e.g. a protector/trap-like effect)
attack goes ahead: attacker loses camouflage
target loses its longrange trait when attacked
assume the defender will hit back unless a trait below prevents it
shuriken: attacker deals pre-combat damage to the target; the result may kill it
reset sentry kill flag, then look at the target's sentry (it hits the attacker first)
no sentry (or done): AI/opponent attacks first play targeting animations and wait (state 8)
replay playback: set up the attack visuals directly
combat begins: switch both cards to combat state and compute damage dealt to the target
skip normal damage if shuriken or sentry already killed the unit
sneak attack: ranged strike, defender does not strike back
terror: play trigger animation and sound, defender does not hit back
sniper that avoids return damage: play particles and ranged attack, no counter-damage
longrange attacker avoiding return damage: same idea as sniper
regular attack: play ranged animation or melee animation depending on attack type
target already killed by shuriken/sentry: skip movement and go to the post-attack broadcast
tell listeners (triggers, UI) that the attack happened
deal the computed damage to the final target (starts its damage coroutine)
find the target's neighbours on its side of the board for splash effects
blast: damage adjacent units of the target
no blast, still need the neighbour list for the stomp check
stomp: one random adjacent unit takes damage equal to the target's current health
defender strikes back unless the attacker's traits prevented it
only if the defender has combat damage greater than 0
counter-damage roll: damage the attacker (state 0x18 waits for the animation)
post-combat cleanup
target's damage animation still running: wait a short delay
queue board reassembly and clear combat highlights on both cards
record the attack in the cemetery log and challenge log
markerlight on target and ranged attack: deal extra damage unless target is already doomed
defender has sentry: sentry damage is dealt to the attacker before normal damage
check if the sentry damage would kill the attacker; if so no return damage
look up the sentry animation info to play the ranged effect
attacker has shuriken: build damage lists to see if it would kill the target
shuriken would kill the defender: flag it so it deals no return damage
get the shuriken animation info and play it, then apply the damage
an ability cancelled the attack: clear pending damage and notify
tell each cancelling unit to resolve its cancel
action type is not 0x4a: check abilities that cancel attacks first
attack not cancelled: go on to finish
common exit: FinishResolvingAction with a flag that is true for the cancelled path
state 3: shuriken animation finished, apply shuriken damage
state 4: shuriken damage dealt; log it and fire the target's Rage trigger
state 5: sentry animation finished, create the sentry damage
state 6: sentry hit; maybe fires the attacker's Ecstasy trigger, then damages the attacker
state 7: sentry damage landed; log it and fire the Rage trigger on the attacker
state 8: show target highlights and enemy targeting animation, wait targeting time
state 9: targeting animation done, begin combat
state 10: sneak attack animation, then a short delay
state 11: sneak attack delay finished, go to post-attack broadcast
state 12: terror delay done; play the ranged attack
state 13: short delay after terror
state 15: sniper particles done; play ranged attack
state 16: short delay after sniper attack
state 18: longrange particles done; play ranged attack
state 19: short delay after longrange attack
state 23: defender's ranged return animation done; continue to counter-damage
states 24/25: counter-damage or damage animation done; continue to cleanup
state 26: markerlight damage done; remove markerlight and finish

32c394c.summary: Coroutine that resolves backlash on the target card: if it has enough pending damage it dies, death abilities fire and the dead unit is broadcast. Waits two seconds after a death, then finishes the action.
comments: state 1: the two second delay after the death has passed
state 0: start
target is already dying or a remnant: go straight to dead-card handling
otherwise check whether it must die from pending damage
not lethal: just finish the action
resolve the death; the result says whether a delay is needed
fire the unit's death abilities
queue a board reassembly for that side
broadcast the dead unit to listeners
mark that backlash has already triggered so it will not repeat
if the card really died, wait two seconds
finish the action (not consumed)

32c3ba8.summary: Coroutine that plays a card automatically (auto-summon) from hand onto the field. Checks a slot is free and the card is in hand, animates it, then updates the unit-in-play counter and list, fires card effects, broadcasts the summon and logs it.
comments: states 1 and 2: the card-move animation (enemy or player version) has finished
ambush units arrive in ambush state
log the auto play and play the 'minion from hand' sound
pick the next free board slot and remove the card from the hand
place the minion on the board, then wait for its conversion animation (state 3)
state 0: start
the action's target card is the card to auto-play
choose the minion manager of the card owner's side
board must have a free slot
card must still be in hand
pick the owner's hand (player or enemy)
enemy card: play the move-into-battle sound and enemy card animation, then state 1
player card: same with the player animation, then state 2
card not in hand: log a warning and cancel
no room on board: cancel auto summon
no card given: log error
cancel path: finish the action as not consumed
state 3: card is on the board; run the minion-played-into-field coroutine
state 4 (decompiler shows this oddly): the minion has entered the field
increment the unit-in-play counter and add the card to the unitsInPlay list
pass the card's effects to the hand manager, then refresh and broadcast the summon
log the troop play in the challenge log and finish successfully

state 0: start; create the card from the target's raw data
build a card for the hand owner's army
start tiny (1% scale)
animate toward the NextToCemeteryMarker object
run CreateCardInGame to grow it to 1.1x scale, then state 1

comments: last step (state 2): the card has moved into the deck
register the card in the deck list
secret cards also tell the other player that a secret was created
finish the action
state 1: creation finished; move the card to the deck
state 0: start; the spellType compare is the decompiler's reuse of the state
log that a deck card is created and show the card
animate it in using the scale and target position (state 1)

32c4c60.summary: Coroutine that creates a card in a hand: animates it in, adds it to the hand, and for sabotage cards shows it centered. Finally broadcasts the creation and applies any attached effect.
comments: state 0: choose the hand of the acting side
show the card and animate it in
state 1: sabotage cards raise an AddSabotageCardSignal and are shown in the center
state 2: after the center display, add the card to the hand
state 3: card is in hand
tell listeners that a card was created
if the action carries an effect, put it on the new card
add the card to the hand (not drawn) and wait for it

comments: state 1: the card is destroyed; take it out of the hand and finish
state 0: card must be in hand
if a destroyed-reflected animation exists, spawn it at the card with the dissolve sound
remove cost effects and destroy the card (0.3s), then state 1
not in hand: log a failure message with player and card state

32c5550.summary: Coroutine that discards a card from hand, showing it briefly, waiting through several delays, destroying it and removing it from the hand before finishing.
comments: state 0: card must be in hand
log (trap state) and show the card being drawn, then wait a short time
not in hand: log failure with card state
state 1: highlight the card; traps also show their description; wait two seconds
state 2: another short wait
state 3: destroy the card (0.3s)
state 4: remove cost effects and the card from the hand, then finish

state 0: card must be in hand
log it, add a display entry to the cemetery log
set the card to playing state and show it in the center for 2.5s
not in hand: log a failure and finish

32c5f18.summary: Coroutine that draws a card for a player or enemy. Handles an empty deck (fatigue, or recycling cemetery cards into the deck), draws the card, adds it to the hand, broadcasts the draw (outside mulligan) and finishes the action.
comments: states 3 and up: drawing already done
states 4/5: the card is in hand; remove it from the deck list
outside mulligan: broadcast the draw; armed traps are resolved and logged
raise the DrawCardSignal
state 3: fatigue finished, just finish
state 0: remember who draws and pick hand and deck
empty deck: log it
normal rules deal fatigue damage; the other mode recycles cards from the cemetery
loop backward through the cemetery for this player's cards
initial-deck card: reset it, undissolve and animate it back into the deck
if a specific card is requested, make sure it is still in the deck
not in deck: ignore the draw
draw the card from the deck
armed trap cards go into hand via the active trap coroutine
regular card: add to hand and wait the draw time
state 1: recycled card created; move it to the deck
state 2: add the recycled card to the deck, then keep scanning
